subject: Installing rstan when no connection to the internet

messages.author: c5ba184f6a4a676b
messages.subject: Installing rstan when no connection to the internet
parts:
Hello All,

I would like to upgrade the version of Stan/rstan on a windows server I work on that has no connection to the internet.  The current installation instructions seem to rely on an internet connection.  Is there somewhere I can go to download the necessary installation files, copy them onto the server and install from the locally stored files?

Many thanks for you help,

Jon.

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Installing rstan when no connection to the internet
parts:
For rstan, you can download https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/releases/download/v2.4.0/rstan_2.4.0.tar.gz

You also need to first install the Rcpp, RcppEigen, inline, and BH packages from CRAN.

Ben
